items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: I’ll play flute, Aaron (our sax player) will play oboe

ctx.x: You’re supposed to have a rehearsal with the piano and the vocalist before you do this. Anyway so that part was left out. And then Paul looks at me with a panic look on his face and he says, “Bones, how are we going to pull this off?” I said, “I’ll play flute, Aaron (our sax player) will play oboe, we’ll hire a French horn, we’ll hire a clarinet, and you’ll

play the string parts on the string synthesizer. There’s your opera.” And we’ve all heard opera. We know, we can —.” So I stayed up all night, did all the stuff, and all night while I was staying up I was thinking to myself Renee Fleming has got to be a real diva. She’s going to be difficult. It turns out to be exactly the opposite. She had a great sense of humor, very easy to work with, just nicest person ever. And I had one of the songs in the wrong key.
